name: Ridge Hill
summary: Ridge Hill is Westchester County's modern lifestyle center that serves as a town square destination, offering an upscale mix of retail, dining, office space, and amenities in an open-air setting. Located in Yonkers, the center provides a contemporary shopping and gathering experience for the affluent suburban communities of Westchester and southern Connecticut.
demographics: Ridge Hill attracts an affluent suburban demographic from Westchester County and surrounding areas, with visitors typically consisting of middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws heavily from nearby Yonkers, White Plains, and southern Connecticut communities, appealing to professionals aged 30-55 and their families who seek a convenient, upscale shopping and dining experience. The center's modern amenities and office component also attract younger professionals and empty nesters who value the mixed-use town square concept with its blend of retail, dining, and entertainment options.
description: Ridge Hill stands as Westchester County's premier lifestyle destination, embodying the concept of a modern town square where community and commerce seamlessly blend. Located at 73 Market Street in Yonkers, New York, this open-air shopping center has transformed the retail landscape of the region since its opening. The center positions itself as the place "where your week begins and ends," offering a carefully curated mix of retail stores, dining establishments, office spaces, and amenities that cater to the discerning tastes of Westchester County residents. With its contemporary architecture and thoughtfully designed public spaces, Ridge Hill provides more than just shopping—it creates a gathering place for the community. The center's tagline invites visitors to "Find Everything You Needed and Didn't Expect," reflecting its diverse tenant mix that combines national retailers with unique dining experiences, all set within an environment that encourages exploration and discovery.
